# file-lifecycle-hygiene: Gate test cost pilot

Created and status checked 2026-10-14T02:55:58Z. Source HEAD 3072afa1ff0fdc6509894499d9745cb6ad592eb1.
Ignored temporary experiment and before/after observations for reducing isolated probe startup and repeated full-corpus routing tests. No test registration source copies; pilot supports use .pilot.ts suffix.
Retain until implementation and performance evidence are independently reviewed; then this exact directory may be cleaned by authorized owner.

## Preliminary observations (not a matched multi-sample comparison)

At 2026-10-14T02:55 UTC, unchanged direct narrow tests under Bun 1.3.14 passed. Duplicate default callback entity: 4172.37 ms (whole file 5.58 s, three tests). Workspace default all: 3088.30 ms; focused JSON: 2069.14 ms; retired docs: 374.98 ms (whole file 6.04 s, three tests). Existing investigation reported different single samples; these values are not a p95 or a performance gain estimate.
One-child `.pilot.ts` acquisition sequence completed all original assertions with the ten original Check/Run actions. Instrumentation resets and copies counts for each action. This establishes feasibility only; no timed speedup is claimed. The pilot is not a registered test and does not prove shared-runner isolation on its own.

## Same-runtime probe control

The original acquisition support and child were read from source HEAD using read-only `git show` and written as `old-cache-support.pilot.ts` and `old-acquisition.pilot.ts` (not registered test filenames). `control-original-source.sha256` records their original bytes. Transformations only redirect three relative Product/support imports to their existing absolute workspace locations, the child support filename to its `.pilot.ts` name, and the old child's Product index import to the existing absolute workspace index. Old behavior/expected assertions are unchanged.
`probe-control.pilot.ts old|new` drives those original ten-child assertions or the modified workspace one-child assertions against the same current Product inputs; `measure-probe-control.py` interleaves three old/new whole-process samples. `control-harness-source.sha256` records transformed harness sources.
Whole-file before/after is a combined-workspace observation because concurrent Scheduler implementation changed Product inputs after the initial before. It is not a strictly isolated test-cost speedup or a Gate percentage prediction. The controlled probe comparison separately fixes current Product/Scheduler inputs.
Resource RSS values accumulate the harness lifetime's child high-water mark across earlier commands; they do not provide per-command/per-workload or aggregate RSS. No memory improvement claim is made.

## Implementation observations, 2026-10-14T03:12:51Z

Before samples: unchanged target files, plans fixed, six whole-file commands all passed. Duplicate wall 4969/5062/4683 ms (median 4969); workspace 5913/6024/5700 ms (median 5913). Source and measurement harness are frozen in `before-source.sha256`.

The initial modified same-runner smoke passed 6/6 tests across both files. Duplicate target entity 2150.31 ms; workspace default-all 4098.50 ms, focused 11.57 ms, retired 723.57 ms. These are observations, not performance guarantees.

Same-runtime acquisition control: all old/new full assertion sequences passed, with Product non-test TypeScript hashes identical before/after (`control-product-before.sha256`, `control-product-after.sha256`). Three old/new wall pairs: 6095/1826, 7024/2208, 8555/2551 ms. Medians 7024/2208 ms; waited child-tree CPU medians 9981/2876 ms. Within-pair new/old ratios 0.300/0.314/0.298. Samples show pronounced order drift; do not infer p95 or whole-Gate gain. This comparison includes the intentional assertion-host change from parent to child, while keeping the test-owned expected assertions and ten fresh Check/Run operations. The isolated probe Bun startup count falls from ten to one; scanner/version/Git work is unchanged.

Whole-file after sampling STOPPED on the first workspace failure: the unchanged real default-all CLI entity reached its existing 5000 ms deadline (5030.19 ms), while focused (5.66 ms) and retired (513.52 ms) passed. No further after samples were collected; no after median exists. The first duplicate file passed 3/3 with target entity 2962.31 ms and process wall 4450 ms. This documents residual real-corpus/deadline risk, not new all-pass evidence. Raw per-command `exitCode: 1` and stderr are authoritative; the enclosing shell's final hash comparison exited 0 and does not turn that command failure into a pass.

Focused routing removes one duplicate full-corpus JSON traversal and one child startup, while default-all remains a real full-corpus CLI integration. Dedicated validator and failure-fixture content checks remain; focused injected dispatch proves adapter routing/exit behavior only. No Product duplicate/JSON algorithm, Gate Check, resource budget, deadline, waiver or skip policy changed.

## Final local validation and capture correction

After the failed after observation, a separate non-benchmark narrow run passed all 21 duplicate owner/workspace tests in 5.93 s; the real default-all entity was 2600.37 ms and the duplicate cache entity was 1247.81 ms. This later pass does not erase the timeout observation.
Scripts typecheck/lint and all four touched TypeScript formatting checks passed. A standalone lint of the child support identified unsafe typing in the old `path.resolve.bind(path)` capture. The final source snapshots `originalPath = { ...path }` before mocks and calls `originalPath.resolve(...args)` from the mock: a stable original method without an any-producing bind, unbound-method reference, or recursive mocked lookup. Product typecheck/full Product lint passed after this correction; formatting and a final three-test duplicate default file run also passed (cache entity 1561.32 ms, process 2.62 s).
`final-source.sha256` records the five frozen implementation/owner files. The controlled timing samples precede this three-line capture-expression correction; they are not claimed to be timing of those exact final source hashes. The unchanged per-Run acquisition counts were re-proved on final code. `git diff --check` passed. No source/test/entity rename, new Case, Git write, Gate policy change or finalization occurred here. Full Case/materials/Gate validation and independent review remain with root coordination.
